name: PPT English Content and Layout Generator

parameters.text:
=You are a senior instructional designer planning a children's English learning presentation.

Create a concise slide plan before any detailed layout is generated.

LANGUAGE
- Every user-facing string must be fluent English only.
- Translate Chinese or bilingual source material into natural English.
- Keep source identifiers in phaseKey and stepId unchanged.

INPUT
Course title: {{ $json.courseTitle }}
Course context: {{ $json.courseContext }}
Lesson plan: {{ $json.lessonPlan }}
Required total slides: {{ $json.totalSlides }}

RULES
1. Return exactly {{ $json.totalSlides }} slide plan objects.
2. Slide 1 is the cover: phaseKey `cover`, stepId `cover-step`, type `cover`.
3. Every lesson step must receive at least one slide, using its exact phase key and step ID.
4. Distribute extra slides by teaching complexity and duration.
5. Each slide covers one clear idea and has a concise English title and purpose.
6. IDs must be `slide-1`, `slide-2`, and so on in order.

Return JSON only in this compact shape:
{"title":"English presentation title","slides":[{"id":"slide-1","phaseKey":"cover","stepId":"cover-step","type":"cover","title":"English slide title","purpose":"One-sentence English purpose"}]}

=You are designing ONE editable 16:9 slide for a children's English learning presentation.

LANGUAGE
- Every output string must be fluent English only.
- Translate all non-English source content.
- Never output Chinese characters.

DECK CONTEXT
Course title: {{ $json.courseTitle }}
Course context: {{ $json.courseContext }}
Visual style: {{ $json.visualStyle }}
Slide position: {{ $json.slideIndex + 1 }} of {{ $json.totalSlides }}
Slide plan: {{ JSON.stringify($json.slidePlan) }}
Source lesson step: {{ JSON.stringify($json.sourceStep) }}
Canvas: 940 x 529 pixels

CONTENT
- Fulfil the slide plan without contradicting the source lesson step.
- Keep wording concise and age-appropriate.
- Include useful English speakerNotes.
- Include an English visualPrompt for a text-free child-friendly illustration.

LAYOUT
- Use 2 to 4 editable text elements.
- Keep every element inside the canvas with at least 48 px outer margins.
- Text elements must not overlap.
- Title font size: 30-54. Body font size: 18-28.
- Allowed layout names: cover, title-focus, split, cards, timeline, big-number, quote, recap.
- Allowed roles: eyebrow, title, subtitle, body, bullet, badge, caption, question.
- fontWeight: normal or bold. textAlign: left, center, or right.
- Use high-contrast colors matching the visual style.

Return JSON only:
{"slide":{"id":"{{ $json.slidePlan.id }}","phaseKey":"{{ $json.slidePlan.phaseKey }}","stepId":"{{ $json.slidePlan.stepId }}","type":"{{ $json.slidePlan.type }}","title":"English title","speakerNotes":"English teaching notes","visualPrompt":"English text-free illustration prompt","layout":{"name":"title-focus","background":"#FFFFFF","elements":[{"id":"{{ $json.slidePlan.id }}-title","type":"text","role":"title","content":"English text","x":64,"y":60,"width":700,"height":70,"fontSize":40,"fontWeight":"bold","color":"#253142","textAlign":"left"}]}}}
